description: An enrollment group on a Tributech Node. Root of the group's agent topology and the level all depth limits are counted from.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Represents the name of the enrollment group. Matches the alias of the corresponding organization.
contents.comment: The enrollment group id itself is not repeated here - it is the twin id, and it is also held in the twin metadata, which is the value the node stamps and the only one that can be trusted.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this enrollment group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this enrollment group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: AgentGroups
contents.description: Top-level agent groups of this enrollment group.

contents.name: UnassignedAgentGroup
contents.description: Reserved agent group holding every agent of this enrollment group that carries no agent group assignment.
contents.comment: Exactly one exists per enrollment group and is created with it, but DTDL requires minMultiplicity to be 0 - the API enforces that the edge is present.
